warning.titlePre: Jaguar X-Type V6 Ignition Coil Degradation
paragraphs: If your X-Type is a V6 model with the AJ-series engine — that's the X400 generation built between 2001 and 2009 — ignition coil degradation is a well-documented pattern on this engine. The coil-on-plug design is often accelerated by oil contamination from leaking valve cover gaskets. We replace ignition coils and valve cover gaskets as standard on every AJ25 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (CarChecker.pro, TrueDelta), per G-BRF Jaguar Section 5. Diesel 2.0d timing belt is a service interval item, not a defect pattern, and is not included as a hero hook per VRF Section 2.
